source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory
actual_process_proof: anetd loads GW private key, accepts unsigned SDK intent, is killed and restarted, returns original task and signature on replay
expiry_proof: Original gateway command expiry survives restart and TCS inbox cleanup; real GW/ICS/TCS lock waits crossing client-certificate expiry reject the request
audit_proof: Signing audit and T1 acceptance audit failures roll back their own transaction; denial audit failure returns Unavailable; client cancellation audited independently; post-commit receipt-read failure is unknown, not definite denial
scope: Single-domain authenticated SDK ingress; not A2A/MCP, agentgateway ExtProc, OAuth/DPoP, disclosure classification, tenant quotas, all transport-level failure audit or full M1 exit
development_correction: First run had an incorrect streaming-RPC test assertion before Recv; corrected to consume the refusal from the stream. Final run had no assertion retry.
